title: Angele Anang wins Drag Race Thailand Season 2
summary: At the Final Runway (TH-S02-E13), Angele Anang was crowned the winner of Drag Race Thailand Season 2, with Kana Warrior and Kandy Zyanide finishing as runners-up.

title: M Stranger Fox: Season 2 Porkchop
summary: M Stranger Fox was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race Thailand Season 2 (TH-S02-E01), losing a lip sync to "Born Naked" against Silver Sonic.

title: Kana Warrior and Kandy Zyanide return to the competition
summary: Kana Warrior (eliminated TH-S02-E05) and Kandy Zyanide (eliminated TH-S02-E04) both re-entered the competition after TH-S02-E08 and went on to finish tied as runners-up.

title: Miss Gimhuay disqualified
summary: In TH-S02-E06, it was revealed that Miss Gimhuay had brought unauthorized props into the TH-S02-E05 runway challenge, violating competition rules. She was disqualified from the competition.
